title: Exploring the underlying structure of mental disorders: cross-diagnostic differences and similarities from a network perspective using both a top-down and a bottom-up approach
limitations: - Limited to five specific mental states; - Participants in each group are heterogeneous; - Descriptive comparison of networks, not statistical; - Subjective interpretation of PCA components.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the main text, but supplementary materials may contain this information. The authors used Stata for analysis and R (qgraph) for visualization.
